description: Hand-checked labels for build-eq-pairs.mjs (reviewed 2026-09-19 by the P0 Source Research agent). Method: for each pair, compare origin-time difference, epicentral distance, magnitude and depth, and look for a *different* USGS event (global M>=4.5 or Euro-Med M3-4.5 lists) within 20 s / 100 km of the EMSC event. If the EMSC event has its own USGS counterpart, the pair is NO_MATCH with high confidence. 'ambiguous: true' marks pairs where both readings are defensible; calibration should report metrics with and without them.
